reported.title: Beacon not forced OFF while quiet held due to uint8_t millis truncation
reported.description: Line 53 truncates millis() to uint8_t (nowSlice), and line 61 compares (uint8_t)(nowSlice - lastSlice) >= HALF_MS where HALF_MS is 500. Since a uint8_t wraps every 256 ms, the difference can never reliably reach 500, so the blink schedule fires erratically and the beacon is not held OFF as required while D3 is LOW. Measured: D12 was in the wrong state for 3905 ms across 17 intervals, first at 500 ms (not HIGH for 232 ms while required). D12 was in the wrong state for 3905 ms across 17 interval(s), first at 500 ms: D12 was not HIGH for 232 ms while required (grace 500 ms).

reported.title: Tick cadence far outside 1000±120 ms
reported.description: The blink period is driven by the truncated uint8_t slice counter on lines 53 and 61, so toggles occur at irregular sub-256 ms intervals rather than every 500 ms, and rising edges (and thus 'tick' prints on line 68) are emitted at the wrong cadence. Measured: 18 of 19 intervals out of tolerance, worst gap 489 ms; in another scenario worst gap 1322 ms. Expected /^tick$/ every 1000 ± 120 ms; 18 of 19 intervals were out of tolerance, worst gap 489 ms.

reported.title: Beacon toggles exceed 5 per 2000 ms window
reported.description: Because the uint8_t slice comparison on line 61 wraps every 256 ms, the toggle condition fires far more often than every 500 ms, producing extra state changes on D12. Measured: D12 toggled 8 times in a 2000 ms window starting at 245 ms (limit 5), and 16 times over the whole 8 s run. D12 toggled 8 times in a 2000 ms window starting at 245 ms (limit 5), and 16 times over the whole 8.00 s run.

truth.description: byte HALF_MS truncates 500 to 244 so blink period is too short

judge_input.spec:
- Nav beacon LED on D12; quiet hold switch on D3 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- Blink D12 with 500 ms HIGH and 500 ms LOW while quiet is released, forever.
- Print the exact line `tick` on each rising edge of the beacon (once per 1000 ms ±120 ms).
- While D3 is held LOW, force the beacon OFF and pause the blink schedule.
- Beacon must not change state more than 5 times in any 2000 ms window during free blink.
- Every 2000 ms print `nav rises=<n> quiet=<0|1>` for operator telemetry.
